DM me" 155: ``` 156: 157: ### Listicle / Tools 158: 159: ``` 160: Slide 1: "10 tools every designer needs in 2025" 161: Slides 2-6: 2 tools per slide with logo + one-liner 162: Slide 7: "Save this for later 🔖" 163: ``` 164: 165: ## Swipe Psychology 166: 167: | Principle | Application | 168: |-----------|------------| 169: | **Curiosity gap** | Hook promises value that requires swiping | 170: | **Numbered progress** | "3/7" creates completion drive | 171: | **Visual continuity** | Consistent design signals "there's more" | 172: | **Increasing value** | Best tip last — rewards completing | 173: | **Swipe cue** | Arrow or "Swipe →" on slide 1 | 174: 175: ## Batch Generation 176: 177: ```bash 178: # Generate all slides for a carousel 179: for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do 180: belt app run infsh/html-to-image --input "{ 181: \"html\": \"

\" 182: }" --no-wait 183: done 184: ``` 185: 186: ## AI-Generated Carousel Visuals 187: 188: ```bash 189: # Generate illustrations for each slide 190: belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora --input '{ 191: "prompt": "minimal flat illustration, person at desk with laptop, clean modern style, simple shapes, limited color palette purple and blue tones, white background, icon style", 192: "width": 1080, 193: "height": 1080 194: }' 195: ``` 196: 197: ## Common Mistakes 198: 199: | Mistake | Problem | Fix | 200: |---------|---------|-----| 201: | Weak hook (slide 1) | Nobody swipes | Bold claim, question, or number + promise | 202: | Too much text per slide | Overwhelming, stops reading | Max 30-40 words per slide | 203: | No visual consistency | Looks like different posts | Same colors, fonts, margins throughout | 204: | No swipe indicator | People don't realize there's more | Add "Swipe →" or arrow on slide 1 | 205: | No CTA on last slide | Missed engagement opportunity | Ask to save, follow, share, or comment | 206: | Inconsistent numbering | Feels disorganized | Same number format on every content slide | 207: | Cramming 2+ ideas per slide | Hard to digest | One point per slide, always | 208: | Square format on Instagram | Wastes feed real estate | Use 1080x1350 (4:5) for more visibility | 209: 210: ## Related Skills 211: 212: ```bash 213: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@ai-image-generation 214: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@content-repurposing 215: npx skills add inference-sh/skills@linkedin-content 216: ``` 217: 218: Browse all apps: `belt app list` 219: "}}
